maddeler.e:
نتناضح (form VI)
# نَتَنَاضَحُ (natanāḍaḥu) /na.ta.naː.dˤa.ħu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of تَنَاضَحَ (tanāḍaḥa)
# نَتَنَاضَحَ (natanāḍaḥa) /na.ta.naː.dˤa.ħa/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of تَنَاضَحَ (tanāḍaḥa)
# نَتَنَاضَحْ (natanāḍaḥ) /na.ta.naː.dˤaħ/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of تَنَاضَحَ (tanāḍaḥa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
